notes: Position overlay: Shift+R (or the switch on the Ranges tab) shows position tags over your poker table, updated about once a second. Taskbar dot shows when it's on (green) or can't read the table (amber). Checks that fail twice in a row save a picture to the 'overlay misses' folder next to the app (Shift+W saves one any time, 300 MB max). R and Read now always read your poker window, never whatever is in front; your poker programs are listed with a remove button.
